sloka: ते तु त्रिभिरहोरात्रैः सम्प्राप्य मधुरामथ ।शत्रुघ्नाय यथातत्त्वमाचख्युः सर्वमेव तत् ।। ७.१०८.२ ॥
transliteration: te tu tribhirahorātraiḥ samprāpya madhurāmatha ।śatrughnāya yathātattvamācakhyuḥ sarvameva tat ।। 7.108.2 ॥

translations.english: Having reached Mathura in three days and nights, they truthfully narrated all the events to Shatrughna.
